4. `.handoffs/inkos-sprint-0{1..12}-lessons.md` — prior build lessons

- Props: `tabs: PageTab[]`, `activeKey: string`, optional `className`
- Each tab: `{ key, label, badge?, gated?, hidden?, icon? }`
- `role="tablist"` + `role="tab"` with `aria-selected`

Apply Nova's density recommendation: if we can legitimately trim to 10-11, do it (e.g., merge MARKETING into MONEY as "Grow"; keep INVENTORY separate). **Use your judgment — if the groups feel right at 8, keep 8. If 4-5 feels cleaner per Nova's "Operate/Manage/Grow/Setup" grouping, try it.** Document your choice in the close note.

### Step 5 — Update sidebar visual DNA (Nova tokens)
`components/app/sidebar/SidebarNavGroup.tsx` + `AppSidebar.tsx`:
- Sidebar width: 240px expanded / 56px collapsed (already matches existing tokens — verify)
- Nav item height: 32px (`h-8`)
- Icons: 16px (`size-4`)

- Label: 13px / font-weight 500 (`text-[13px] font-medium`)
- Section headers: 11px uppercase tracking-wider (`text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider`)
- 16px gap between groups (`space-y-4` on content, or `mt-4` on each group)
- Active state: **full background fill** with primary-tinted bg (`bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold`) — replaces any left-border stripe
- Plan-gated items: show with PlanBadge, right-aligned (not hidden)

### Step 6 — Tab hosts (4 pages)
Per Vega §3:

**`app/(app)/appointments/page.tsx`** — tabs: All / Today / Waitlist (default: All)
  - "All" = current list

  - "Schedules" = render `/artists/schedules` inline
  - "Guest Artists" = render `/guest-artists` inline (gated: pro)
  - "Permissions" = render `/settings/team/permissions` inline (owner/admin only)

**`app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx`** — tabs: Stock / Ink Registry (default: Stock)
  - "Ink Registry" = render `/settings/ink-registry` inline

For tab pages, keep each underlying page file as-is so its URL still works (Step 7 handles redirects). Extract the CONTENT into a reusable client component if it helps (e.g., `ClientsAllList`, `TagsList`, `AiDesignGallery`) so the tab host composes them. Don't duplicate logic.

Per Vega §4. Add `async redirects()` returning:
```ts
[
  { source: '/artists/schedules', destination: '/artists?tab=schedules', permanent: false },
  { source: '/guest-artists', destination: '/artists?tab=guest-artists', permanent: false },
  { source: '/settings/team/permissions', destination: '/artists?tab=permissions', permanent: false },
  { source: '/settings/ink-registry', destination: '/inventory?tab=ink-registry', permanent: false },
  { source: '/settings/tags', destination: '/clients?tab=tags', permanent: false },
  { source: '/consent-forms', destination: '/clients?tab=consent-forms', permanent: false },
  { source: '/ai-design', destination: '/clients?tab=ai-design', permanent: false },

```
(Don't collapse `/settings/*` → `/settings/studio/profile` yet — that's S14.)

### Step 8 — BottomNav update
`components/shared/BottomNav.tsx`:
- 5 slots: Home / Schedule / **New** (center FAB, elevated) / Clients / More
- "New" slot: 56×56 elevated button (`-translate-y-4`), Electric Purple bg, `shadow-soft-md`, opens a quick-create menu (Sheet from bottom with: New appointment, New client, New consent, New invite)

- Base-ui `render={<X/>}` pattern — no `asChild`
- `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true` conditional spread
- 0 raw hex (except brand `#0a0a0f` + `#7c3aed`)
- 0 default Tailwind shadows
- 0 `any` — Sprint 9 lesson
- 0 `console.*` — use `lib/logger`
- Don't break any existing route — every old URL must either work or redirect

- Navigate to `/guest-artists` → lands on `/artists?tab=guest-artists`
- Every top-level nav item clicks through

## Commit strategy (7-9 commits)
1. `feat(nav): PageTabs + PlanBadge primitives with URL persistence`
2. `refactor(nav): consolidate nav-config.ts 31 → <N> items across <G> groups`
3. `refactor(nav): sidebar visual DNA — 32px items, 11px section headers, full-fill active state`
4. `feat(appointments): tab host (List / Today / Waitlist)`
5. `feat(clients): tab host (All / Tags / AI Design / Consent)`
6. `feat(artists): tab host (Roster / Schedules / Guest / Permissions)`
7. `feat(inventory): tab host (Stock / Ink Registry)`
8. `chore(routing): redirect map for old nav paths`
9. `feat(mobile): BottomNav center-FAB + More sheet trigger`
10. `feat(dev): /dev/design Section 24 Navigation`

Every commit: typecheck + lint + build clean.

Final push: `git push origin main`.

Close note to `.handoffs/inkos-sprint-13-lessons.md`. Return 200-word summary.

1	# InkOS — Sidebar Consolidation + Tenant Switcher + Settings Redesign
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	The 12-sprint hardening program shipped. Post-launch usability review surfaces three linked problems in the app shell:
6	
7	1. **Sidebar is too dense.** Owner on Pro sees **31 items across 9 groups** (nav-config audit). Cognitive load is high; new users can't find what they need. Competitors show 6–10 top-level items, surface sub-features via in-page tabs.
8	
9	2. **Settings is fragmented.** 13 separate `/settings/*` routes, most with their own sidebar entry. This violates the Stripe / Vercel / Linear pattern (single settings route with internal sub-nav).
10	
11	3. **No tenant switcher.** `studio_members` is N:M but `app/(app)/layout.tsx` loads only the first membership (`.limit(1).single()`). A user who owns/joins a second studio cannot reach it. InkOS also has multi-location support (`locations` table) with zero UI to switch between locations.
12	
13	**User framing:** "Rankora has a workspace switcher at the top — does InkOS need one?" Rankora's switcher is **feature-based** (Hiring vs Agency — two apps in one shell), not multi-tenant. For InkOS, two distinct needs exist:
14	
15	- **Studio switcher** — real multi-tenant, for users with >1 studio membership (db already supports; UI missing).
16	- **Location switcher** — within a studio, for the location-aware views (calendar, inventory, bookings).
17	
18	**Goal:** Addictively simple navigation — 7–9 top-level items, everything else surfaces as tabs on the destination page. Production-grade, competitor-beating (Stripe / Linear / Fresha / Notion level).
19	
20	---
21	
22	## Design Decisions (locked)
23	
24	### 1. Navigation consolidation: 31 items → 8 top-level
25	
26	**New sidebar structure:**
27	
28	```
29	HOME
30	  • Dashboard
31	
32	SCHEDULE
33	  • Calendar
34	  • Appointments          (tab inside: All • Today • Waitlist)
35	  • Booking page
36	
37	CLIENTS
38	  • Clients               (tab inside: All • Tags • AI design • Consent forms)
39	
40	TEAM
41	  • Artists               (tab inside: Roster • Schedules • Guest artists • Permissions)
42	
43	MONEY                    (everything financial collapses here)
44	  • Payments
45	  • Commissions
46	  • Payroll
47	  • Reports
48	
49	MARKETING
50	  • Campaigns
51	  • Referrals
52	
53	INVENTORY
54	  • Inventory             (tab inside: Stock • Ink registry)
55	
56	SETTINGS                 (single top-level entry — see §3)
57	```
58	
59	**Result:** 8 groups, **13 sidebar items** (down from 31). Everything else becomes in-page tabs.
60	
61	Plan-gated items keep their current gating (Pro / Studio / Enterprise) — shown with badge, not hidden. Role-gated items remain role-filtered.
62	
63	### 2. Top-bar tenant switcher
64	
65	**What gets built:** A unified "context switcher" in the header left (next to the breadcrumb) that adapts to what the user has:
66	
67	- **Single studio + single location** (most users) → switcher is hidden; shows only the studio name as a breadcrumb crumb
68	- **Single studio + multiple locations** → Location pill only ("Downtown Studio ▾")
69	- **Multiple studios** → Studio pill ("Ink Haus ▾") that opens a dropdown of all studios; optionally also Location pill if the active studio has >1 location
70	
71	**Not a Rankora-style feature switcher.** Rankora switches between two app modes — InkOS has one app, multiple tenants.
72	
73	**Data:** lift the `.limit(1).single()` in `app/(app)/layout.tsx` → fetch all `studio_members` for the user. Track active studio in an `X-Active-Studio` cookie (or URL segment for better deep-linking — see implementation plan §3.2).
74	
75	### 3. Settings: 13 routes → 1 hub route with internal nav
76	
77	**New structure:**
78	
79	```
80	/settings                  (default: redirects to /settings/studio)
81	  Left sidebar 240px (internal to /settings):
82	    Studio
83	      • Profile
84	      • Branding
85	      • Services
86	      • Booking policies
87	      • Ink registry
88	      • Booking page
89	    Team
90	      • Members
91	      • Roles & permissions
92	    Subscription
93	      • Plan & billing
94	      • Usage
95	    Integrations
96	      • Connected apps
97	    Account                 (per-user, not per-studio)
98	      • My profile
99	      • Advanced
100	```
101	
102	Each sub-page is its own route (`/settings/studio/profile`, etc.) so direct links work. But the shell (sidebar within /settings) is shared — matches Stripe / Vercel.
103	
104	**Current pages keep their files** but get reorganized:
105	- `/settings/page.tsx` becomes a hub that redirects to `/settings/studio/profile`
106	- Each sub-page stays where it is (or moves one directory deeper) with a `SettingsLayout` wrapper
107	
108	---
109	
110	## Competitive Benchmarks (the bar)
111	
112	| Pattern | Primary |
113	|---|---|
114	| Sidebar density (8 top-level, sub-features as tabs) | **Linear** (7 top-level), **Notion** (5 workspace sections) |
115	| Settings hub with internal sub-nav | **Stripe**, **Vercel**, **Linear**, **Notion** |
116	| Tenant switcher (multi-workspace) | **Linear** workspace picker, **Notion** workspace picker, **Stripe** account switcher |
117	| Location switcher (within tenant) | **Fresha** location picker, **Square Dashboard** location picker |
118	| Badge for plan-gated items | **Vercel** Pro/Team badges, **Linear** upgrade prompts |
119

import type { Metadata } from 'next'

    data: { user },

  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const { data: member } = await supabase
    .from('studio_members')
    .select('role, studio_id')

    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
